title: render_profile_v1
description: v5.0 2.24. Sole authority for export-format settings. Field-level decision (owner, 2026-09-23): render_profile_v1 keeps profile_version, NOT stage_version -- these are distinct concepts (stage_version = pipeline-stage/producer implementation-contract version; profile_version = export-profile identity/content version), and this artifact is the one exception to the impl-plan-0 blanket stage_version rule because it is not itself a pipeline-stage output in the same sense as the other artifacts -- it is a configuration object the render stage consumes. Faithful to v5.0's literal JSON example, which has no stage_version field.
